business.body:
- India's 1st 2-hour fashion delivery platform, a one-point shopping solution for women spanning fashion, makeup, jewellery, crockery and footwear, with delivery live across Delhi NCR and Jaipur.
- Aims to be India's leading quick-commerce destination and a global platform fulfilling every woman's lifestyle needs, having already entered Australia.
- Differentiates on verified/genuine brand curation, a unified woman-centric shopping experience, uniform online-offline pricing and hassle-free returns versus fragmented, slower e-commerce alternatives.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Seasonality] Business is seasonal; company entering its most important 8-9 month stretch driven by festive, wedding and peak consumption periods.
- [Digital Reach] 69.7K combined social media followers (43.1K Instagram + 26.6K Facebook), with marketing spend of ~₹46.5 lakhs/month including influencer marketing.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: WomanCart positions itself as India's first 2-hour fashion-and-beauty quick-commerce platform built exclusively for women, scaling its own-brand portfolio and omni-channel store network across Delhi NCR, Jaipur and Australia toward a global women's-lifestyle destination.
